assignmentHtml.task: Research The geeta gurjar YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator/creator - who is Geeta Gurjar? Family members? (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages. (6) Primary content category. (7) Content supply model. (8) Representative works. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: The geeta gurjar is #26/#27 with ~69B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for The geeta gurjar with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml: Comprehensive dossier for The geeta gurjar YouTube channel, with all requested fields and source-backed findings.

evidence.snippet: Rank 28: The geeta gurjar, Link: https://www.youtube.com/@Thegeetagurjar, Views: 63.6 billion, Content category: People, Country: India, Primary language(s): Hindi
evidence.supports: Channel ID alias @Thegeetagurjar, country India, language Hindi, content category People, lifetime views ~63.6B (Wikipedia snapshot)

evidence.snippet: Created On: Jan 26, 2021. Subscribers: 43.8M. Views: 69,746,509,842 (≈69.75B). Videos: 4,421. Last 30 days: 400K subscribers gained, 1.55B views, 60 videos uploaded.
evidence.supports: Channel creation date Jan 26, 2021; current stats 43.8M subs, ~69.75B views, ~4.4K videos; high-frequency supply model (~60 uploads/month)

evidence.snippet: Title: 'My First vlog | Aadiyogi shiva statue Coimbatore || The geeta gurjar'. Views: 121,122. Date published: Jul 18, 2022. Channel: The geeta gurjar (43.8M subscribers).
evidence.supports: Earliest still-public upload is 'My First vlog' dated July 18, 2022 — despite channel creation on Jan 26, 2021, no public uploads exist before this date.

evidence.snippet: The geeta gurjar (@thegeetagurjar), Categories: Family & Parenting, Daily vlogs. Subscribers: 43.8M. Views: 69.7B. Avg likes: 14K. Image URL confirms Channel ID: UCUL9We-R1aCC3GAe-RvOx5g.
evidence.supports: Content categories: Family & Parenting and Daily vlogs; Channel ID UCUL9We-R1aCC3GAe-RvOx5g; India-based ranking #54

evidence.snippet: Birthday: August 17. Birth Sign: Leo. Birthplace: India. Profession: YouTube Star. About: Indian content creator renowned for engaging family-oriented posts. Before fame: launched YouTube channel on January 26, 2021. Trivia: amassed over 36 billion views. Family life: daughter Amaira involved in many videos.
evidence.supports: Creator is Geeta Gurjar (born Aug 17, India); channel launch date Jan 26, 2021; daughter Amaira featured in videos; family-oriented content

evidence.snippet: Geeta Gurjar is an Indian YouTuber... Based in Jaipur. She has experience working as a Business Process Manager at Wells Fargo Financial Services. She uses broad humor in her videos... Most viewed video: 'Amaira the Fashionista #shorts' with 65M views.
evidence.supports: Operating location: Jaipur, Rajasthan; former profession Wells Fargo BPM; first vlog about Adiyogi Shiva statue in Coimbatore with daughter Amaira

evidence.snippet: Geeta Gurjar, one of three girls born in Uttar Pradesh... Girls in her neighbourhood were not allowed to attend school, but Geeta's father made sure she did. She began to feel her dream of being self-sufficient fading as she married and had children while pursuing her MSc... She earned her B.Ed... One day, randomly scrolling through YouTube, she realised that she possessed skills in video editing and loved making videos of her family life.
evidence.supports: Creator background: born in Uttar Pradesh, one of three sisters; educated despite local gender norms; MSc, B.Ed.; married; discovered YouTube after realizing she could combine family life content with video editing skills

evidence.snippet: March 25, 2024: 'amaira ne li pichakari #thegeetagurjar #shorts', 2,00B views, The geeta gurjar — listed among top most-viewed YouTube shorts of all time.

evidence.supports: Second channel operated by same family: 'Amaira gurjar vlogs' with ~2.94M subscribers, featuring daughter Amaira's content alongside The geeta gurjar

evidence.snippet: Featured channels include 'Amaira gurjar vlogs' alongside 'The geeta gurjar' — indicating dual-channel operation under same family brand.
